messages:
sara: PR #482 is up — kv-cache eviction bugfix. PTAL when you have a sec, cc @rajan @mike. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/482

rajan: quick skim, looks good overall. left two tiny nits inline about a var name and a comment. also CI flaky test in smoke/run-36 failing occasionally — do you see that locally?

sara: thanks — I saw that. addressed the var/name nit and updated comment. added a retry in smoke test to avoid flake. pushed -> force-pushed.

mike: ptal — I can give final approval if CI passes. fyi: perf benchmark showed +0.8% token throughput on our internal micro-bench but memory slightly up.

sara: added perf note and baseline numbers in PR description. also added a short changelog entry.

deploy-bot: CI build #2189 succeeded — all checks green. :white_check_mark:

rajan: looks good now. one more question: can we add a unit test for eviction edge-case? the integration test may not catch the race.

sara: added unit test in the new commit — test_kv_eviction_race. It's small and deterministic. I'll re-run CI.

carmen: PTAL on the test if you get a minute, trying to avoid surprises in prod.

mike: reviewed the unit test, good. Approving now. :thumbsup: 

sara: thanks all — merging after the 10-min grace window unless anyone objects.

rajan: no objections. :+1: 

sara: merged — 1718925210. tagging release branch for tomorrow's deploy.
